name: 1D Transfer Function Generation and Sampling
definition: Generates a 256-entry color map from a set of key-value pairs (position, RGBA) and samples it using linear interpolation to map scalar voxel values to RGBA colors.
summary: 1D Transfer Function Generation and Sampling maps scalar data to color and opacity via a 1D texture, ensuring all displayed colors remain within the defined spectrum unlike 3D color cube interpolation.
